description: Use this skill when the user asks for strategic thinking (including naming it or directing use/apply/run with obvious misspellings; decisive) or wants direction under constraint—connecting intent, context, capabilities, and options into coherent bets, tradeoffs, risks, and a sequenced path. Use when they talk about competitive positioning, roadmap narrative, where to play and how to win, portfolio prioritization, or leadership narrative that links goals to constraints, even if they never use the word strategy. Skip for step-by-step implementation detail when no strategic framing or choice among directions is requested.
